verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same serious flaws. The address is squeezed into a cramped, tiny three-line stack ('4275 / Country / Club Dr') beside the date. 'keaton.us' and 'SHOWROOM' are too small to read. The second photo is left-aligned and stops well short of the right edge, so it looks disconnected from the patterned panel and leaves a lopsided gap on the right. A adds a large dead white area at the bottom with only a thin top margin. B shifts everything down so the empty space above and below is more even, which makes it slightly less unbalanced.
